paper_title: New Examples of Minimal Non-Strongly-Perfect Graphs
summary: The informal conjecture suggests that the characterization of outerplanar strongly perfect graphs can be obtained from the minimal non-strongly-perfect examples constructed in the paper. No follow-up resolving or substantially advancing this specific question was found in the May 2026 review.
